retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic cyan-tinted portrait featuring a central figure with dynamic, left-aligned outline typography that follows a diagonal descending path.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic blue-tinted photograph of a man in a suit, set against a blurred forest background. The layout is defined by heavy outline typography in the upper left and a black rectangular tracklist block in the lower right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a slight upward gaze
Typography follows the diagonal line of the subject's shoulder
High contrast between the cyan highlights and deep navy shadows
Text blocks balance the composition across opposite corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, centered horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large outline text in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, follows the diagonal descent of the words to the subject's face, then moves down to the dark tracklist block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred forest background provides textured negative space that maintains the monochromatic theme.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with limited hue variance; monochromatic duotone.

letterConstructionRules: No internal fill for display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Outline geometric sans for primary branding paired with solid condensed sans for secondary messaging.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular box for tracklist

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, high-x-height lowercase structure.
Appropriate for the secondary uppercase staircase text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochromatic cyanotype-style photograph of a man in a 1960s suit against a blurred forest, ensuring deep navy shadows and bright cyan highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white outline geometric sans-serif text in the top left. Add a diagonal 'staircase' of solid white uppercase text following the shoulder line. Place a black rectangle in the bottom right with small white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic blue?
Does the secondary text follow a diagonal descending path?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the staircase text alignment
mustRedesign: Solid fills on the primary display text

avoid: Default Arial or Times New Roman fonts

postGenerationChecks: Confirm black box placement in lower right
recipe.reuseFormula: Cyan Duotone + Outline Geometric Sans + Staircase Alignment = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
